description: Rank commodity categories for a reporter by trade value for a given flow direction and period. Returns the top N HS chapters (2-digit) or headings (4-digit) sorted by descending value — answers "what does country X mainly export?" or "what does country X mainly import?". Symmetric counterpart to comtrade_get_top_partners. Optionally filter to a single partner country.

aggr_level.description: HS aggregation level: 2 = chapter (broader), 4 = heading (more specific).

limit.description: Maximum number of top commodity categories to return.

partner_code.description: M49 partner code to filter to a specific bilateral relationship. Omit to rank commodities across all partners.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country.

name: comtrade_get_top_commodities

commodities.description: Top commodity categories sorted by descending trade value.

primaryValueUsd.description: Trade value in USD (FOB for exports, CIF for imports).

sharePercent.description: Share of total trade value among returned commodities, as a percentage.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no data is returned.

totalCommodities.description: Total commodity categories returned by API.

totalValueUsd.description: Sum of primary values across all returned categories (before limit).

truncated.description: True when API returned 500 records and results may be incomplete.

title: Get Top Trade Commodities
